resources.string: Choose how ALMI connects to AI. Each connection has its own screen, models and status.
Connect your account, browse models, compare pricing and use automatic fallback.
Enter any compatible provider, endpoint, API key and model IDs manually.
Automatically connect only to verified providers that do not require you to create or paste a personal API key.
API secrets are stored locally in Android Keystore. ALMI never ships private provider credentials inside the APK.
Connect OpenRouter directly or enter your own key, then choose the exact text, image or video model you want.
Sign in and let ALMI receive the API key through OpenRouter OAuth.
Paste an OpenRouter key and choose free-only or paid-enabled access.
Direct mode is intentionally limited to free models. You can still choose which free model is preferred.
Connected. ALMI can use this OpenRouter key.
OpenRouter connection failed. Try again or use a manual key.
OpenRouter did not expose a numeric remaining limit for this key, so ALMI will not invent a remaining-count estimate.
Search, compare capability and price, then tap a model to make it your first choice.
No matching models are available for this filter right now.
Free model; provider rate limits still apply.
Exact unit price is not exposed in the current catalog payload.
Remaining usage depends on the current free-model rate limits.
≈ %1$d small chat turns at the shown remaining credit
≈ %1$d images at the shown remaining credit

Fallback is automatic: ALMI tries your selected model first, then the next compatible models, and then the next enabled OpenRouter key. OpenRouter provider-level fallback remains enabled as well.
Use this when you want full control over the provider, endpoints and model IDs.
The API key is encrypted in Android Keystore. Other connection settings are stored separately.
Creates an optional motion clip from the result.
Custom API is saved and active.
Automatic AI without your own API key
ALMI checks only verified providers that can be reached without asking you to create or paste a personal API key. The best reachable route is selected automatically.
On — ALMI automatically checks and selects the best no-key route.
Off — your regular OpenRouter route remains available.
The no-key provider check could not complete. Check your network and retry.

Only providers that do not require a personal API key are listed here. ALMI tests the provider directly and selects the highest-ranked reachable integrated route. If it becomes unavailable, the next verified no-key route can be selected automatically. Providers that require an account key stay in OpenRouter or Custom API instead.
